title: Gate decision artifact schema
description: The human's decision at a gate, recorded by the orchestrator so that human oversight is committed evidence.

target.description: The main artifact decided on. Workspace-relative path.

decision.description: The human's decision. One of: accepted | accepted-with-concerns | rejected.

decidedBy.description: The human (name or role) who decided.

concerns.description: The human's concerns or conditions, in their words. Empty when none.

stepOutcomes.description: Step outcome record: one entry per step that committed this artifact.
Step outcome record. Every workflow step that commits this artifact appends exactly one entry, so the artifact itself carries the step's decision and the agent's reply stays indicative.

step.description: `<workflow-slug>/<step-slug>` of the step that appended this entry.

outcome.description: written (created) | revised (content changed) | confirmed (reviewed, still valid) | no-change (out of scope on this run) | none (not needed; the artifact records that decision).

note.description: One line: what the step decided and why.

friction.description: Optional. Workflow friction the actor observed (raw input for Inspect and Adapt, never a fix).
